issue.yaml: Front matter is not valid YAML: {error}
issue.yamlNoMapping: Front matter must consist of key: value lines.
issue.unknownKey: Unknown key “{key}” in the front matter.
issue.missingTitle: Front matter without title – the flow gets no tile.
issue.frontMatterUnclosed: Front matter is not closed with “; ---”.
issue.titleNotLiteral: Step without a fixed R title – an R{'{'}…{'}'} expression cannot be matched.
issue.duplicateTitle: R title “{title}” occurs more than once in this file.
issue.noCompletion: Flow without the line echo ";; Completed" – the UI never reports it as completed.
issue.callWithoutC0: Calls the flow {flow} without C0 – its line echo ";; Completed" would report the calling flow as completed.
issue.markupRemoved: Contains markup that is removed when shown: {removed}
issue.templateCall: Jinja calls a function – only filters and range() are allowed. The text is not evaluated.
issue.templateForbidden: Jinja accesses “{name}”. The text is not evaluated.
issue.templateRebind: Jinja overrides “{name}”. The text is not evaluated.
